spans.s:
Bhṛṅgā is the name of a species of bee, later specified as large and black, in the Atharvaveda and the yajurveda Saṃhitās, which include it in the list of victims at the aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’).
Foot notes ix. 2, 22.
Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 8; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 29. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 96.
